features.name: age_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalization of age using training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a scaled continuous feature for the linear SVM, preventing the age variable from dominating the margin due to its larger scale.

features.name: height_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalization of height using training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Scales the height variable to have zero mean and unit variance, improving convergence and margin calculation in linear models.

features.name: is_bay_area_core
features.description: Binary indicator for whether the user lives in the core Bay Area cities (San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley).
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a linear decision boundary separating core urban residents from others, which may correlate with specific professions or lifestyles.

features.name: is_male
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct linear shift for gender, allowing the SVM to learn gender-specific baseline offsets.

features.name: graduated_college_plus
features.description: Binary indicator for having graduated from a 4-year college or higher degree program.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates sparse high-education categories into a single robust binary feature for the linear model.
features.formula: np.where((education == 'graduated from college/university') | (education == 'graduated from masters program') | (education == 'graduated from ph.d program') | (education == 'graduated from law school') | (education == 'graduated from med school'), 1.0, 0.0)

features.name: drinks_frequently
features.description: Binary indicator for frequent alcohol consumption.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates the high-frequency drinking behavior into a linear feature, separating it from social or non-drinkers.

features.name: drugs_never
features.description: Binary indicator for never using drugs.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a clear linear separation between strict non-users and those who use drugs sometimes or often.

features.name: smokes_no
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a distinct linear feature for the absence of smoking behavior.

features.name: education_level_score
features.description: A continuous score from 0.0 to 1.0 representing the level of formal education attained or in progress, where 0.0 is high school dropout and 1.0 is a completed Ph.D. or Med School.
features.expected_model_benefit: Maps a complex categorical variable with many levels into a single monotonic continuous feature, ideal for linear SVM weights.

features.name: fitness_orientation_score
features.description: A continuous score from 0.0 to 1.0 representing the degree of physical fitness or athletic lifestyle implied by body_type, where 1.0 is highly athletic/fit and 0.0 is not.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous semantic projection of body type, allowing the linear model to capture fitness as a magnitude rather than sparse categories.

features.name: astrology_seriousness_score
features.description: A continuous score from 0.0 to 1.0 representing how seriously the person takes astrology based on the 'sign' column, where 1.0 means it matters a lot and 0.0 means it doesn't matter or is missing.
features.expected_model_benefit: Extracts the sentiment modifier from the complex 'sign' strings into a continuous linear feature, ignoring the specific zodiac sign.

features.name: lifestyle_conventionality_score
features.description: A continuous score from 0.0 to 1.0 representing how conventional the user's lifestyle is based on orientation, status, and substance use, where 1.0 is highly conventional.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a weighted composite of several lifestyle choices, providing a dense, continuous feature that a linear SVM can easily utilize.
